🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Susan Saint James, the Emmy-winning actress who starred opposite Rock Hudson on McMillan & Wife and alongside Jane Curtin on the sitcom Kate & Allie, has died at 80.

Saint James died on Monday, October 26, 2026, after being diagnosed with pancreatic cancer, her representative told People magazine. Her death certificate, obtained by People and reported November 5, listed the cause as metastatic pancreatic cancer and stated she died months after her diagnosis.

Born Susan Jane Miller on August 14, 1946, in Los Angeles, Saint James grew up in Rockford, Illinois, and began modeling as a teenager before turning to acting, according to her Hollywood Walk of Fame biography.

She broke through as editorial assistant Peggy Maxwell on the NBC drama The Name of the Game, which ran from 1968 to 1971. The role earned her eight Emmy nominations over her career, including a win in 1969 for her supporting performance.

Her next major role paired her with Rock Hudson on McMillan & Wife, which debuted in 1971. As Sally McMillan, she helped her husband, San Francisco Police Commissioner Stewart McMillan, unravel criminal cases over six seasons.

In 1984, Saint James joined Jane Curtin in Kate & Allie, playing Kate McArdle on the CBS sitcom about two divorced friends sharing a home and raising their children together. She received lead actress Emmy nominations for the comedy in 1984 and 1985. She was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in June 2008.

In a statement to People, her family remembered Saint James as “generous with her time and energy, which she valued more than money, and instinctively drawn to whoever needed lifting up.” The family also recalled how, weeks after losing her youngest son, Teddy, in a November 2004 plane crash, she delivered his eulogy as a note to each of her other children and her husband, giving them words to heal.

Saint James is survived by her husband, television executive Dick Ebersol, four children and seven grandchildren.

Sources: People magazine (via Saint James' representative and family statement); The Associated Press; USA TODAY.

title: Beyond the 956: Susan Saint James, 'McMillan & Wife' and 'Kate & Allie' star, dies at 80
